Asha Nair: Candidate Zoe Kim's final loop is scheduled 7am PT which is 11pm KST for her. She mentioned shes commuting from Busan. Can we move to a more reasonable hour or provide an in-person option in Seoul?
Evan Brooks: We can do 3pm PT (7am KST) which is early but doable. Alternatively, we can arrange an in-person at our Seoul partner workspace. Does she need any travel reimbursement?
Marta Li: Zoe said she could attend in-person if travel covered. She prefers Linux for the coding task; we have a Dell laptop at Seoul hub. Need to ensure Docker + toolchain installed.
Asha Nair: RecruiterBot: please schedule partner room Seoul-Desk-2 and set Zoom fallback. Also note: candidate requests live captions and extended time for coding task.
RecruiterBot: Room booked. Shipping is unnecessary if Zoe can come in. Please DM me the candidate's preferred dates so we can arrange transit reimbursement.
Evan Brooks: I'll follow up with Zoe re: dates. Marta  can you image the Dell with our test env if she chooses in-person?
Marta Li: Yes will image; estimate 2 hours. Asha, please mark 'loaner-preferred' in Greenhouse if Zoe asks for remote laptop.
Asha Nair: Will do. Also can we prepare an employer leave confirmation letter (not visa)? RecruiterBot: prepare template and route.
RecruiterBot: Employer leave template created; route initiated to People Ops for approval.
Asha Nair: Thanks everyone. I'll update the candidate and post confirmation once Zoe picks a time.
